name: meeting-app
files.meeting-app/.mrmr/space/personas.yaml:
version: 1
personas:
  - id: designer
    summary: Product UI in this repo
    asks:
      - UX review of a flow or screenshot
    requests:
      - critique an artifact
  - id: qa
    summary: Breaks the happy path
    asks:
      - empty states, auth, pagination edges
    requests:
      - a repro, not a vibe
